correctness.rationale: Direct chip-firing at one grain per occupied vertex transports each binary grain to its successor, so the entire list of firing supports is S+t modulo n (no transient). Because gcd(n,k)=1, multiplication by k^(-1) modulo n is a permutation taking R_a={a,a+k,...,a+(L_a−1)k} to exactly L_a successive residues. Its translated faces give the complete circular-interval nerve N(n,L_a−1), and complementary supports likewise N(n,n−L_a−1). Verify Adamaszek et al Theorem 3.6: when (k−2)/(k−1)<r/n<(k−1)/k one gets S^(2k−3), with equality at lower endpoint producing wedge of n-r-1=L_a copies of S^(2k−4). Algebra r/n>(k−2)/(k−1) iff q+s>(1+δ_a)(k−1), precisely T_a>0; equality similarly. Independently enumerated all eight support translates and their modular images for n=8,k=3,a=0,1,2: interval facet equality holds, T=(0,0,2). Full 2014 theorem, not finite homology, proves all parameters and integral homotopy types. The R_a result needs k<n/2 style bound L_a−1<n/2, true for q≥2 and n=kq+s.
